The pirate [[Hunter Maas]] owned a red '''R3-series astromech droid''' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After Maas stole the map to the [[hyperspace nullifier]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] astrocartographer [[Essio Galassian]], he stored the map inside the droid.
